title: Training Q&A: Buyer-Paid Upfront Fee and the Builder Extended Rate Lock Rate
content:
**Q: Does the upfront fee the buyer has paid change the locked rate of a Builder Extended Rate Lock?**
A: Yes. The paid share is the lock fee payments on the lock ledger as a percent of the loan amount on the lock. A paid share of 1.0 percent or more takes 0.125 points off the rate; a paid share above zero but below 1.0 percent takes 0.0625 points off; none takes nothing off.

**Q: What kind of points are these?**
A: Percentage points of interest rate, taken off the locked rate before it is held at no less than the par rate and rounded.

**Q: Which payments count?**
A: Every lock fee payment on the lock ledger, added together.

**Q: How do the bands read?**

| Paid share of the loan amount | Off the rate |
|---|---|
| none paid | nothing |
| above zero, below 1.0 percent | 0.0625 points |
| 1.0 percent or more | 0.125 points |

**Q (hypothetical): loan amount USD 300000.00 and lock fee payments of USD 1500.00?**
A: Paid share 0.5 percent: 0.0625 points off. With payments of USD 3000.00 the share is exactly 1.0 percent: 0.125 points off.
